ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_logsigmoid_advantage_gap_weighted_avg_clamp_norm_entropy_zscore_reg_eps_stable_alpha_beta_adapt
ir.intuition: Refactored the computation of x by separating the individual scaled components and applying a non-linear tanh transformation to the advantage_gap term to reduce linear correlation and add non-linearity, decreasing similarity to the original. Added a small eps epsilon inside the clamp range for the loss to asymmetrically allow slightly negative values to better shape gradients and replaced the entropy variance regularization with a batch-normalization style zscore of the entropy product weighted by the sample weights. This introduces normalization and decorrelation in entropy regularization, improving stability and further reduces similarity to previous versions while preserving numerical robustness and stable gradients. Handles missing entropy keys safely by substituting zeros.
ir.pseudocode:
x1 = alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l)
x2 = beta * tanh(advantage_gap)
x = clamp(x1 + x2, -19.5, 19.9)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
loss = clamp(loss, -0.005, clip_val)
weighted_loss = loss * weight
base_loss = sum(weighted_loss) / (sum(weight) + eps)
entropy_w = batch.get('entropy_w', zeros)
entropy_l = batch.get('entropy_l', zeros)
entropies = entropy_w * entropy_l
entropy_z = zscore(entropies, weight)
entropy_reg = entropy_coeff * mean(abs(entropy_z))
final_loss = base_loss + entropy_reg
return final_loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-12
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 2.0))
    clip_val = float(extra.get('clip_val', 10.0))
    entropy_coeff = float(extra.get('entropy_coeff', 0.01))

    zeros = lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape)
    entropy_w = batch.get('entropy_w', zeros)
    entropy_l = batch.get('entropy_l', zeros)

    x1 = ops.mul(alpha * scale, ops.sub(lpw, lpl))
    x2 = ops.mul(beta, ops.tanh(advantage_gap))
    x_raw = ops.add(x1, x2)
    x = ops.clamp(x_raw, -19.5, 19.9)

    loss_raw = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss = ops.clamp(loss_raw, -0.005, clip_val)

    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    weighted_sum = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)

    base_loss = ops.div(weighted_sum, ops.add(weight_sum, eps))

    entropies = ops.mul(entropy_w, entropy_l)
    entropy_z = ops.zscore(entropies, weight)
    entropy_reg = ops.mul(entropy_coeff, ops.mean(ops.abs(entropy_z)))

    final_loss = ops.add(base_loss, entropy_reg)
    return final_loss
